title: 第287章 人联第286章 世界划分
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
第287章人联！！
第一项议题的扯皮比罗恩预想的要长多了。
原本定下来一天搞定的事情，硬是扯皮了三天。
那些王国们在三大势力面前唯唯诺诺，但在一群同层次的选手里可都是重拳出击。
一个个的都化身内战幻神！
要不是在三大顶尖势力的调停下达成了一份临时协议。
估计泰伦世界的第一次世界大战，就要开始了。
临时协议以各方先以现有实际控制区域为基准，划定临时边界。
争议区域由学城组织测绘队重新勘定，勘定结果作为下一轮谈判的依据。
这个方案不算完美，但至少让会场里那些吵得面红耳赤的代表们有了一个台阶下。
罗恩的辉银王国居然还意外地分到了漩涡海里的几座海岛。
这倒是个意外之喜。
但目前来看用处也不大。
各地都缺人的情况下，罗恩不太可能往外海移民的。
老法师见场面稳定下来，没有给众人太多喘息的时间，直接宣布进入第二项议题。
“诸位，泰伦世界已经完成了位面晋升。
而机械世界的发现更是让我们重新认识了星海。
未来的路，我们绝对不会只碰见这一个世界。
那些星海中的茫茫世界。
弱小的还好说，要是遭遇传闻中的恶魔、炼狱。

我们该如何应对呢。
我想我们必须要提前做好应对的准备了。
机械世界的战争给我们提供了一个重要的教训——各自为战、缺乏统一协调的作战方式，让我们付出了本可以避免的代价。
接下来泰伦世界如果要向星海进一步拓展，我们需要一个更加紧密、更加高效的组织形式。”
所以这次泰伦会议的另一重点。
就是组建一个属于我们泰伦人类的星海开拓组织。
也就是人类联盟！！
简称“人联！！！”
老法师说完，侧身让出位置，把发言权交给了圆桌方向。
古德里安率先开口。
他没有像刚才那样只说简短的表态，而是展开了一整套构想：
“这个星海开拓组织——人联，是我提议成立的。
这个组织的职能是统一协调泰伦世界，人类各方势力在星海拓展中的所有重大行动。
包括但不限于位面战争、资源勘探、新世界的殖民开发，以及对外星智慧种族的接触与交涉。”
他顿了顿，目光扫过全场，继续补充道：
“人联不干涉各成员势力的内部事务，也不替代各国的主权。
它只负责三件事：第一，制定统一的星海拓展战略，避免重复投入和资源浪费；
第二，建立共享情报和资源的平台，让有能力的势力获得支持，让暂时落后的势力有追赶的机会。
同时避免遭遇更强大的世界，暴露泰伦世界的坐标。
第三，在外敌来临时，形成统一的防御和反击力量。”

第287章人联！！
这番话让会场安静了好几息。
content_en:
Chapter 287 People’s Alliance! !
The debate on the first issue took much longer than Ron expected.
What was originally scheduled to be done in one day ended up taking three days.
Those kingdoms were submissive in front of the three major forces, but they all fought hard against a group of players of the same level.
Each and every one of them transformed into a phantom god of civil war!
Had it not been for a temporary agreement reached under the mediation of the three top forces.
It is estimated that the First World War in the Tyran world is about to begin.
The provisional agreement requires all parties to first delineate temporary boundaries based on the existing actual control area.
The disputed area will be re-determined by the surveying and mapping team organized by the school city, and the demarcation results will be used as the basis for the next round of negotiations.
This plan is not perfect, but at least it gives the noisy and red-faced representatives in the venue a step down.
Ron's Silver Kingdom was unexpectedly assigned to several islands in the Whirlpool Sea.
This was an unexpected surprise.
But it doesn't seem to be of much use at the moment.
When there is a shortage of people everywhere, it is unlikely that Ron will immigrate overseas.
Seeing that the situation had stabilized, the old mage directly announced the second topic without giving everyone much time to breathe.
“Everyone, the world of Tyran has completed its plane promotion.
The discovery of the mechanical world has given us a new understanding of the sea of ​​stars.
In the future, we will definitely not encounter only this world.
Those vast worlds in the sea of stars.
It's okay to be weak, but if you encounter the rumored devil and purgatory.
How should we respond?
I think we have to prepare for it in advance.
The war in the mechanical world has provided us with an important lesson - fighting independently and lacking a unified and coordinated combat method has cost us avoidable costs.
If the Tyrannic world wants to expand further into the star sea, we will need a closer and more efficient organizational form. "
So this is another focus of the Tyran meeting.
It is to form a star sea development organization belonging to us Terran humans.
That is the Human Alliance! !
Referred to as "People's Alliance!!!"
After the old mage finished speaking, he stepped aside to give up his position and gave the right to speak to the direction of the round table.
Guderian spoke first.
He did not just make a brief statement like before, but developed a whole set of ideas:
“This Xinghai development organization, the People’s Federation, was proposed by me.
The function of this organization is to unify and coordinate all major actions of the Terran world and all human forces in the expansion of the star sea.
Including but not limited to plane wars, resource exploration, colonization and development of new worlds, and contact and negotiation with alien intelligent races. "
He paused, looked across the audience, and continued to add:
“The Awami League does not interfere in the internal affairs of member forces, nor does it replace the sovereignty of each country.
It is only responsible for three things: first, formulating a unified Xinghai expansion strategy to avoid duplication of investment and waste of resources;
Second, establish a platform for sharing intelligence and resources to allow capable forces to gain support and allow temporarily lagging forces to have a chance to catch up.
At the same time, avoid encountering a more powerful world and exposing the coordinates of the Tyranid world.
Third, when foreign enemies come, form a unified defense and counterattack force. "
Chapter 287 People’s Alliance! !
These words made the venue quiet for several breaths.
